newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end sharply up, off day's high.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end sharply up, off day's high.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended sharply up on Wednesday on bullish sentiment but off the new accounts day's high, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange's 100-share index ended 19.36 points, or 1.20 percent, up at 1636.53, after rising to 1,652.88 in earlier trading. Gainers led losers 163 to 124.

The prices fell before the close on profit-taking and rumours, denied by police, of a bomb blast in Karachi, one dealer said. Engro Chemical rose 6.00 rupees to 180, Adamjee Insurance 5.00 to 104, Fauji Fertiliser 3.00 to 79, HUBCO 0.35 to 39.60 and PTCL 0.30 to 30.80. - Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
